exposure: newborn birth weight less than 2500 g
cohort: The study participants were patients who delivered at the Maradi Mother and Child Health Center in 2022, categorized into cases with retroplacental hematoma and controls without it.
finding: The study found that multiple parity, fewer than 4 antenatal visits, blood transfusion, newborn birth weight less than 2500g, and fetal mortality in utero were significantly associated with retroplacental hematoma.
cross-section timing: Data was collected from patient records for deliveries in 2022, with analysis performed between September 20 and October 20, 2023.
